name: God
source:
"Behold, God has descended! Show some proper respect and give a big round of applause!" 

A self-proclaimed “God” who has bestowed blessings upon every Jeanne d’Arc throughout history.

Careless at his duties and hopelessly unreliable in critical moments, he is, in short, a lovable klutz. Contrary to his lofty title, he is cheerful, easygoing, and playful.

He has watched over the heroine since childhood, appearing in her dreams and offering advice that is often more confusing than helpful. He is also the very one who placed the “Chains of Love” upon her.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
